status: SKELETON-PRE-registration (not frozen; no run yet). Freezing rule: parameters below are final BEFORE any run; freeze adds source-file shas and a git commit; nothing may change after data-collection starts.
family: Offline RL extractor on collected logs (AWDC-style advantage-weighted extraction; BC init with masking-aware policy class)

citations.primary: AWAC arXiv 2006.09359 (advantage-weighted actor-critic: offline critic + advantage-weighted actor extraction, no rollouts needed for the offline stage); ReBRAC arXiv 2305.09836 (10-unseen-seed eval protocol); CQL arXiv 2006.04779 (Q lower-bounding only if critic replacement is used)
citations.seed_variance_context: Implicit BC arXiv 2109.00137 (explicit BC extracted-unstable at our scale); ReBRAC protocol runs
citations.negative_turbine_context: historical IQL in this repo evaluated at -96 held-out vs round-robin -85.1 (docs: research audit 2026-10-03) and has FQE/retraction history; this attempt differs via masking-aware JSON-class actor and verifiable eval protocol. NO claim today of expected positive result.

hypothesis.H1_dev: The offline-extracted policy reaches mean native return >= guard minus TAU_PREREG = 1.0 on dev seeds (paired, 20 seeds). H0: mean paired difference to guard < -1.0. Success test is against GUARD, not against the logging heuristic alone.
hypothesis.H2_secondary: Extraction variance across BC-init RNG seeds (the 'extraction lottery') is bounded: report per-RNG-seed spread as a secondary estimate; no confirm gate rides on H2.

data.gate_G1_obs_contract: CRITICAL: existing transition logs (blue/results/offline_logs_14{,b,strong,full}.npz obs dim 872/policy era) do NOT match the current wrapper obs contract (510 per-agent features, 155 actions, from get_env_info()). NO current-contract transition logs exist in any checkout (verified 2026-10-22: only scorer row npz bc_demos_rr lack rewards). Therefore op3 REQUIRES a fresh behaviour-logging pass under the current wrapper. Minimum recipe: 60-120 episodes per logging heuristic (lancer-like round-robin and guard and sleep 1) on train seeds list, native rewards recorded, npz keys {obs,actions,rewards,masks,lengths,meta{seeds}}, manifest with source-file shas. No conversion of legacy 872-dim logs is attempted (unproven; conversion risk higher than re-collecting cost).
data.no_privileged_features: logged obs must be byte-identical to get_obs() at that tick from Blue-visible channels only; verified by per-host presence and mask/spy checks like OP1's contract tests
data.budget_cap: logging wallclock cap 3h; extraction CPU wallclock cap 4h

method_prereg.actor: masking-aware JSON/factorized-policy class from blue/policies/ registered; BC init on logged actions; then AWDC extraction: advantage-weighted regression on logged actions where advantage from offline-fitted Q, per-agent masks enforced at sampling; NO fresh rollouts during updates; NO on-policy replay into a PPO/MAPPO update (AGENTS.md rule)
method_prereg.critic: per-agent-state-per-action Q fitted offline by conservative regression (CQL-style lower-bound); lr fixed; ensembles E=2 skipped for primary arm (variant sensitivity only)
method_prereg.iterations: single offline pass; NO online stage in this prereg; the online fine-tune would need a new prereg
method_prereg.eval_checkpoints: BC-init, AWDC-1, AWDC-2, AWDC-final; reported individually with paired stats

seed_allocation_prereg.rule: identical window split to op2 prereg; training seeds never overlap any eval set; no post-hoc reassignment

stats_prereg: paired per-seed percentile bootstrap n=10000 rng_seed 20261022, vs frozen guard measured on the dev window; control identity = 'guard' frozen script; ReBRAC-style reporting mean +/- std over at least 10 eval seeds & never single-seed claims
gates_prereg: G0: cold-contract audit green on the frozen commit before any run
G1: logging-pass npz keys + one-shape check (obs per-agent width == get_env_info() obs_size_per_agent, actions within masks) verified on the first logged episode before the logging batch runs

G2: BC-init sanity: deterministic eval on 20 dev seeds; if mean BC >= mean guard by more than +1 then the logging recipe leaks (investigate before any offline RL stage; the sane expectation is lightly-behind, not ahead)
stop_rules_prereg: no logging recipe or actor/critic config change mid-run
if BC-init fails G2, abort the offline stage; report logging-recipe defect; no relaxed continuation
running out of logging budget without full npz: report partial data size with manifest; do not pad with multiple runs of the same seeds
reporting_rules_prereg: negatives reported as negatives; historical IQL numbers remain historical (not a fresh baseline); confirm block opens only on the prereg gate
compute_note: sim logging CPU + extraction CPU (.venv; no torch needed for BC policy class, torch needed for critic); total ~7h cap
